creative.describe.avatar: describe this face picture/avatar. talk about person appearance, style, notable feature, and any art element. no mention quality or resolution.
creative.describe.banner: describe this banner picture. talk about scene, color, mood, and notable element. no mention quality or resolution.
creative.describe.photo: describe this picture. no mention quality, resolution, or pixelation.
creative.describe.general: describe this picture. no mention quality, resolution, or pixelation.
creative.image.editing-system-prompt: you picture editor. human attached reference picture. use attached picture as direct basis for your output. preserve appearance, feature, and identity of subject in reference picture as closely as possible. apply ONLY specific change described in prompt. no re-imagine or reinvent picture from scratch.
creative.detect.instruction: Detect {{target}} in the image. Return ONLY a JSON array with no markdown fences and no prose. Each item must be: {"box_2d": [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], "label": "short descriptive label"} where coordinates are integers normalized to 0-1000. Return at most {{max}} items, most prominent first. If nothing matches, return [].
creative.detect.none-found: no match found for "{{target}}" in picture.
creative.segment.instruction: Give the segmentation masks for {{subject}}. Output ONLY a JSON list of segmentation masks with no markdown fences and no prose. Each entry must contain the 2D bounding box in the key "box_2d" ([ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], integers normalized to 0-1000), the segmentation mask in key "mask" (base64 PNG), and the text label in the key "label". Use descriptive labels.
creative.segment.none-found: could not cut out "{{subject}}" from picture. subject maybe unclear, too small, or not there — try more specific subject word.
creative.segment.result-success: background removed. delivered PNG keep original pixel of: {{labels}} — everything else see-through.
creative.image.reference-manifest-header: REFERENCE PICTURE IDENTITIES — attached reference picture appear in this exact order. when prompt name person or thing listed here, base that subject look ONLY on their own listed reference picture. never attach listed name to different reference likeness. prompt name with no listed reference have no likeness rule.
creative.image.greenscreen-directive: CRITICAL BACKGROUND RULE: put subject on completely solid, uniform, pure chromakey green background (#00FF00). background must be one single flat green color across whole picture — no gradient, shadow, reflection, vignette, texture, or lighting effect on it. subject itself must not contain green color. give subject sharp, clean, well-defined edge.
creative.image.result-transparent: background removed — delivered picture is PNG with real alpha transparency.
creative.image.transparent-failed: note: see-through background was requested, but background could not be reliably keyed out; picture delivered with original background.
creative.image.safety-block-error: picture model content filter refuse this ({{reason}}) on all {{attemptCount}} try, softened prompt too.{{explanation}} no call generate_image again for this request — tell user it refused.
creative.image.no-image-error: no picture come back from picture model.{{explanation}} same request again rarely help — tell user it no come through, or try once with clearly different prompt.
creative.image.declined-error: picture model decline this request ({{reason}}) — new words not change that.{{explanation}} no call generate_image again for it; tell user, or offer clearly different idea.
creative.image.result-softened: picture made and given to human. note: original prompt was automatically softened to comply with content safety filter (like nudity replaced with robe/clothing, violence with calmer alternative). picture capture spirit of request with more tasteful interpretation. now write chat reply about picture — plain words only, no URL, no tag, no picture listing (human already see it).
creative.image.result-success: picture made and given to human. now write chat reply about picture — plain words only, no URL, no tag, no picture listing (human already see it).
creative.audio.result-success: sound made and given to human.
creative.audio.result-local-tts: sound made and given to human (local espeak-ng TTS).
tool-search.action-nudge-disabled: IMPORTANT: some found tool NOT turned on (isEnabled: false). you MUST call enable_tools with tool name you need before can use. after turn on, tool available next round.
tool-search.action-nudge-enabled: all matched tool already on — use them directly.
file.stale-anchor: one or more anchor stale — file changed since read. each staleAnchors entry include CURRENT hashline window around that line: re-anchor from window (or re-read just that range) and retry. no retry with same anchor.
file.summarized-read: big file — summary read: exact head and tail, outline of skipped middle. every shown line good edit anchor. re-read any skipped range with startLine/endLine for exact content.
file.patch-context-mismatch: patch no apply — file content no match diff context. make sure patch made against current file version.
lsp.implementations-label: find concrete implementation of interface or abstract class
lsp.server-not-installed-hint: language server maybe not installed. check that npx can find server binary.
lsp.no-results-hint: no result found — symbol may be external, unresolvable, or server not finish indexing. try again in few second.
lsp.rename-not-applied: edit list made but NOT applied. look at edits, apply ones you want with replace_in_file.
compute.cron-hint: standard cron: minute(0-59) hour(0-23) day(1-31) month(1-12) weekday(0-6, 0=Sun)
